title: A Cost-Aware Agentic Architecture for NL-to-SQL over Nested Enterprise Schemas, with a New Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2609.04641v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural-language-to-SQL systems have ad- vanced rapidly on academic benchmarks, yet production enterprise schemas exhibit graph- like, semi-structured, deeply nested structure that current benchmarks do not measure. We make two complementary contributions. First, we introduce the DevRev NL2SQL bench- mark: 900 execution-verified queries with nested-type and link-graph structure, accom- panied by the Semantic Depth Score (SDS), a schema-agnostic rubric for analytical reasoning depth. Second, we present a cost-aware single- generation agentic architecture whose schema- selection, metadata-retrieval, and error-repair components are designed for the requirements this regime imposes. On the DevRev NL2SQL benchmark the system attains 91.7% answer correctness, a margin of 54.6 percentage points over the next-best baseline; on the Spider 2.0 Snowflake public dataset, it is competitive with leading systems at a single-generation operating point.

translated_title: 一种面向嵌套企业模式的成本感知型自然语言转SQL代理架构及新基准
translated_abstract: 自然语言转SQL（NL-to-SQL）系统在学术基准上取得了快速进展，然而生产环境中的企业模式呈现出图状、半结构化、深度嵌套的结构，这是当前基准测试无法衡量的。我们做出了两项互补的贡献。首先，我们推出了DevRev NL2SQL基准测试：包含900个经执行验证的查询，具有嵌套类型和链接图结构，并配有语义深度评分（SDS），这是一种与模式无关的分析推理深度评估标准。其次，我们提出了一种成本感知的单次生成代理架构，其模式选择、元数据检索和错误修复组件均针对此类场景的需求而设计。在DevRev NL2SQL基准测试中，该系统达到了91.7%的答案正确率，比次优基线高出54.6个百分点；在Spider 2.0 Snowflake公开数据集上，它在单次生成的工作点下与领先系统具有竞争力。
tldr: 该论文提出了包含900个经执行验证的嵌套结构查询的DevRev NL2SQL基准测试及语义深度评分标准，并设计了一种成本感知的单次生成代理架构，在企业级深度嵌套模式下达到91.7%的答案正确率，领先次优基线54.6个百分点。
